divergences.upstreamResult: Nuqs ships Next, Remix, React Router, and TanStack Router adapters.
divergences.octaneResult: The Octane binding ships standalone React-style, custom, and testing adapters only.
divergences.rationale: Router-specific adapters require renderer-specific ports and integration contracts.
divergences.consumerImpact: Applications using a router-specific Nuqs adapter must provide an Octane custom adapter.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use @octanejs/nuqs/adapters/react or unstable_createAdapterProvider from the custom adapter.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when the corresponding Octane router integrations are available.

divergences.upstreamResult: nuqs/server exports createSearchParamsCache backed by React.cache.
divergences.rationale: Octane does not implement the React Server Components cache primitive.
divergences.consumerImpact: Request-scoped cached search-param access is not available through this helper.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane gains an equivalent request-scoped cache primitive.

divergences.upstreamResult: Nuqs imports TransitionStartFunction from React's type declarations.
divergences.octaneResult: The binding declares the compatible function shape locally.
divergences.rationale: The Octane package intentionally carries no React type dependency.
divergences.consumerImpact: The structural callback shape is preserved without React type identity.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Use the exported structurally compatible callback type.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if a shared renderer-neutral transition type is introduced.

divergences.upstreamResult: NuqsTestingAdapter resets the shared update queue during every render.
divergences.octaneResult: The Octane adapter resets the queue once per mount before child hooks consume it.
divergences.rationale: Repeated render-time resets abort pending debounced writes under Octane's update scheduling.
divergences.consumerImpact: Pending debounced writes survive adapter re-renders.
divergences.migrationGuidance: No consumer change is required; do not rely on re-renders aborting queued writes.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if queue ownership or adapter scheduling changes.
